summary: Backend testing of new Scam Wall feature (/api/scams) — 18/18 pytest cases passed. Covers create (auth required, validation 422 for short title/story, success returns score=0), list (sort=top by score desc, sort=new by created_at desc, my_vote null when unauth and correct when auth), get by id (200 valid, 404 invalid), and voting (auth required, invalid string -> 400, upvote, idempotent re-upvote, switch up->down, remove with 'none', two users counted independently, my_vote correct per-user).

minor.issue: Returns 403 (HTTPBearer auto_error=True) where 401 is more semantically correct. Tests accept both. Same pattern as previously-flagged analysis endpoint.
VoteReq.vote is a free-form str; literal enum (Literal['up','down','none']) would produce automatic 422 at model layer rather than the manual 400 inside the handler. Current behavior is acceptable.
Sorting is done in-memory after fetching ALL posts (up to 500). For >500 rows results would silently truncate. Consider Mongo-side sort + pagination.
_enrich_scam issues 2 count_documents + 1 find_one per post — N+1 problem. For larger feeds, use a single aggregation ($lookup + $group) to compute upvotes/downvotes/my_vote in one round-trip.

action_items: Optional: change VoteReq.vote to Literal['up','down','none'] for automatic 422 (cleaner than manual 400)
Optional: replace per-post count_documents in _enrich_scam with a single aggregation pipeline
Optional: return 401 (with WWW-Authenticate) on missing token via custom dependency; consistent across all auth endpoints
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 646 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend extracting Scam Wall into routers/scams.py and auth into routers/auth.py before further growth.
Dead helper: `async def get_optional_user(authorization)` at line 553 is defined but never called — duplicated inline in list_scams and get_scam. Either use it everywhere or remove.
Inline JWT decoding logic for optional-auth is duplicated in list_scams and get_scam — extract into a shared dependency.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projections everywhere — good.
Voting model lacks a Mongo unique index on (scam_id, user_id). Upsert prevents duplicates today, but a unique index would harden against race conditions.
evidence_url is accepted as Optional[str] with no URL validation — consider HttpUrl/AnyUrl for safety (currently low risk since it's only echoed back).
test_credentials: Fresh users created per session via /api/auth/signup with test_<uuid>@cs.io / pass123!
seed_data_creation: Created 2 fresh users and ~5 scam posts (prefixed 'TEST scam report ...'). Not cleaned up — small accumulation in db.scam_posts and db.scam_votes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scam Wall pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_scam_wall.py covers all 15 scenarios from the review request (mapped to 18 test functions). Runs in ~6s. Class-scoped fixtures share seeded posts. Voting tests rely on ordering within TestVoting class — keep order intact when extending.
rca of the issue: No bugs. All endpoints behave per spec: ScamPostOut returns score/upvotes/downvotes/my_vote correctly, voting is upsert-based and idempotent, switching up<->down decrements/increments correctly, 'none' removes the vote, two users vote independently, my_vote is per-authenticated-user and null for anonymous/non-voters, validation 422 fires for title<4 and story<20, 404 for missing post id, 403 for missing bearer token.
